__prompts__.full_name: Package author's name (used in pyproject.toml metadata)
__prompts__.email: Package author's email (used in pyproject.toml metadata)
__prompts__.github_owner: GitHub user or organization the repo will live under
__prompts__.project_name: Project name, as it will appear on PyPI (e.g. my-package)
__prompts__.project_slug: Import name (must be a valid Python identifier)
__prompts__.minimum_python_version: Oldest Python version to support (sets requires-python and the CI matrix)
__prompts__.copyright_holder: Copyright holder named in the BSD 3-Clause LICENSE
__prompts__.host_docs_on_github_io: Host docs on github.io (public repos only)? 'no' omits mkdocs and the docs workflow
__prompts__.publish_to_pypi: Publish to PyPI on tag? 'no' still creates a GitHub release
